# Philly School Data Explorer

> Open, linked data on Philadelphia's public schools (district and charter): enrollment, catchments and assignment zones, buildings, attendance, outcomes, and how they change over time. Every value carries its source and a status. Facts and fair comparisons, never rankings.

## Start here
- [Data model](docs/DATA_MODEL.md): tables, grains, design rules
- [Source manifest](sources/manifest.csv): every upstream dataset, URL, cadence, charter coverage, license
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): rules for querying and for contributing
- [Contributing and design rules](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Data gaps](docs/DATA_GAPS.md) ([CSV](sources/gaps.csv)): what is missing and why; check before concluding data does not exist
- [Archiving priorities](docs/ARCHIVING_PRIORITIES.md)

## Data
Released as Parquet/GeoParquet (plus CSV) on the GitHub Releases page. Query directly with DuckDB. License: CC BY 4.0 for our compiled data (LICENSE-DATA); source data keeps its publisher's terms.
